name: directly sourced
whitepaper_definition: Whitepaper §5.1 Tier A (firm-verified): direct product-level or market-level data from firm reports, CDP responses or verified databases. Guideline §7.1: firm discloses bilateral sales volumes by model and powertrain.
operational_rule: The value is read, for this country and this quantity, from the authoritative publisher of that quantity (national inventory, registration or certification authority, statistics office, the firm's own market-side release), on the population the model uses, without conversion beyond units.

name: estimated or derived
whitepaper_definition: Whitepaper §5.1 Tier B (estimated): cross-referenced from operating-country deployment registries, firm regional disclosures and market data. Guideline §7.1: regional powertrain mix plus product line-up.
operational_rule: The value is built from authoritative sources for this country but needs a documented step: a conversion with a published factor (label km/L to gCO2/km), a pro-rata of a sector target to passenger cars, a split by production shares, a population that is close but not identical (all light-duty vehicles for passenger cars), or a rounding rule (lifetime from mean age).

name: proxy
whitepaper_definition: Whitepaper §5.1 Tier C (proxy-based, fallback only): applied when Tier A and B sources are exhausted; representative selection with documented rationale. Guideline: declare Tier C where national statistics are unavailable.
operational_rule: The value comes from another population, market, year or average: an EU-average distance for a member state, a share from a source whose level disagrees with the national one, a survival schedule fitted to another era, a mean age biased by an open-ended band, an ICE-central assumption for an unsplit nameplate, a world pro-rata path in place of a national one. Results with more than half of their units on tier-C inputs are directions, not magnitudes (guideline §5.3).
